pull_request.title: fix(storage): validate credential documents and gate import on an existing key
pull_request.author: senamakel

commits.message:
feat(security): store HTTP credentials in encrypted file backend

HTTP credentials and profiles now persist through the encrypted file backend instead of the previous storage path, with layout helpers updated to resolve the new credential locations. This keeps secrets encrypted at rest and consolidates credential storage under one backend.

Auto-committed-on: dragonfly

test(storage): cover dry-run import listing and richer credential fixtures

The credential migration tests now use full credential documents instead of minimal stubs, and a new case checks that a dry run lists only the files it would actually import. The encrypted file backend also gets a formatting-only line wrap.

Auto-committed-on: dragonfly

test(storage): use a valid credential document in the leave-in-place test

The fixture wrote a bare JSON array, which is not a credential document, so the test could pass for the wrong reason. It now writes a document with an empty profiles list and asserts that exact content survives untouched.

Auto-committed-on: dragonfly

chore(vendor): bump tinybus and tinymcp submodules

Updates the vendored tinybus and tinymcp submodules to their latest commits.

Auto-committed-on: dragonfly

fix(vendor): restore main's tinybus and tinymcp pins

A checkpoint after the upstream merge recorded the stale pre-#7521
checkouts, so the merged build lacked the tinybus/tinymcp APIs that
main's mcp host uses (pin_owner, object_at, ClientTable cleanup).

Co-authored-by: Medulla <medulla@tinyhumans.ai>

feat(security): store secrets in an encrypted file backend

Added an encrypted file backend for secret storage so secrets can be persisted without relying on an external keyring, and wired the storage layout to expose its path.

Auto-committed-on: dragonfly

test(storage): cover resumed dry run listing recorded imports

Adds a test asserting that a dry run resumed from a saved layout state lists the credential files the finished import recorded, so the plan reflects prior progress rather than re-deriving it.

Auto-committed-on: dragonfly
